description_en: Queries the health check reports for specified internal-facing applications within a specified time range. The reports include the health check mode, latest status, success and failure counts, and failure details
description_zh: 查询指定内网访问应用在指定时间范围内的健康检查报告，包含健康检查模式、最近状态、成功与失败次数以及失败明细
name: DescribeApplicationHealthCheckReports

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the internal-facing applications. You can specify up to 100 application IDs
parameters.help_zh: 内网访问应用ID集合。最多可输入100个内网访问应用ID
parameters.name: application_ids

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds. If this parameter is not specified, the default value is 5 minutes before the end time. If only the end time is specified, the start time is set to 5 minutes before the end time
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间。Unix时间戳，单位为秒。未填写时默认取查询结束时间前5分钟；仅填写结束时间时，取结束时间前5分钟
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds. If this parameter is not specified, the default value is the current time. If only the start time is specified, the end time is set to 5 minutes after the start time. The end time must be later than the start time, and the maximum query time range is 7 days
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间。Unix时间戳，单位为秒。未填写时默认取当前时间；仅填写开始时间时，取开始时间后5分钟。不得早于或等于开始时间，且查询区间最大为7天
parameters.name: end_time

Reports.description_en: The list of health check reports

ApplicationId.description_en: The ID of the internal-facing application

FailedAddresses.description_en: The list of addresses where health checks failed
FailedAddresses.description_zh: 健康检查失败的地址列表

items.description_en: The address where the health check failed

FailedRegions.description_en: The list of regions where health checks failed
FailedRegions.description_zh: 健康检查失败的区域列表

items.description_en: The region where the health check failed

FailureCount.description_en: The number of failed health checks within the query time range
FailureCount.description_zh: 查询区间内健康检查失败的次数

FailureReasons.description_en: The list of reasons for health check failures
FailureReasons.description_zh: 健康检查失败的原因列表

items.description_en: The reason for the health check failure

HealthCheckStatus.description_en:
The status calculated based on the latest check result. Valid values:
normal: The success rate of the latest check is greater than or equal to 95%.
partialError: The success rate of the latest check is greater than 0 and less than 95%.
error: The success rate of the latest check is 0.
uncompleted: No check results are available
HealthCheckStatus.description_zh:
按最近一次检查结果计算的状态，枚举值：
normal：最近一次检查成功率大于等于 95%。
partialError：最近一次检查成功率大于 0 且小于 95%。
error：最近一次检查成功率为 0。
uncompleted：尚无检查结果
HealthCheckStatus.title_en:
按最近一次检查结果计算的状态，枚举值：

partialError：最近一次检查成功率大于 0 且小于 95%。
error：最近一次检查成功率为 0。
uncompleted：尚无检查结果。
HealthCheckStatus.title_zh:
按最近一次检查结果计算的状态，枚举值：

Mode.description_en:
The health check mode. Valid values:
OnAccess: on-access check
Continuous: continuous check
Mode.description_zh:
健康检查模式，取值：
OnAccess：按访问检查。
Continuous：持续检查

SuccessCount.description_en: The number of successful health checks within the query time range
SuccessCount.description_zh: 查询区间内健康检查成功的次数
